meta.title: Vendor quick switch
meta.description: A vendor index beside the existing model menu. Side panel (default): the index stays next to the menu while it is open, including after drilling into the model list, and clicking a vendor jumps to that vendor inside the existing list, so the shipped list is the second level and no submenu is added. In menu: no side list, the lists expand inside the shipped menu. Surfaces reuse the shipped menu tokens, vision-plugin routes are filtered out, and the original selector is never modified or disabled. Optional: remaining-credit badges on vendor rows, probed per source that actually exists on this machine and falling back silently to the Magpie quota API when available; unavailable balances show nothing, mismatched units are never summed, and no placeholder numbers are ever displayed.
